title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
summary: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.
title_es: OpenAI anuncia GPT-6 Astra para aplicaciones empresariales
bajada: OpenAI presenta GPT-6 Astra, su modelo más capaz para negocios, con razonamiento avanzado, capacidad de uso de computadora y mejor juicio en escritura y diseño. Este modelo representa un salto significativo en las capacidades de IA para tareas empresariales complejas.
bajada_en: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model for business, featuring advanced reasoning, computer use abilities, and improved writing and design judgment. This model represents a significant leap in AI capabilities for complex business tasks.

title: Now everyone can put data to work
summary: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.
title_es: OpenAI lanza Data agent para ChatGPT Work
bajada: OpenAI presenta un agente de datos en ChatGPT Work que permite conectar datos empresariales y crear dashboards interactivos usando lenguaje natural. La herramienta busca democratizar el acceso a análisis de datos sin requerir conocimientos técnicos avanzados.
bajada_en: OpenAI introduces a Data agent in ChatGPT Work that enables connecting company data and creating interactive dashboards using natural language. The tool aims to democratize data analysis access without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

title: Universal Music is launching an AI music platform with ElevenLabs
summary: Universal Music Group is launching a new AI-powered platform that will allow users to draw from its catalog of licensed music to create song remixes, mashups, and new takes on tracks, according to an announcement on Thursday. The record label is developing the platform through a multi-year licensing agreement with ElevenLabs, a company that specializes […]
title_es: Universal Music y ElevenLabs lanzan plataforma de música IA
bajada: Universal Music Group desarrolla una plataforma de IA con ElevenLabs que permite crear remixes y mashups a partir de su catálogo licenciado. El acuerdo multianual marca un importante paso en la integración de IA en la industria musical con consentimiento de derechos de autor.
bajada_en: Universal Music Group launches an AI platform with ElevenLabs enabling users to create remixes and mashups from its licensed catalog. The multi-year deal marks a significant step in AI integration within the music industry with copyright consent.

title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
summary: OpenAI and GSA will offer eligible federal, state, local, and tribal governments $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support.
title_es: OpenAI ofrece acceso gratuito a gobiernos estadounidenses
bajada: OpenAI y GSA acuerdan ofrecer a gobiernos federales, estatales, locales e indígenas licencias sin costo y 50% de descuento en uso, además de soporte mejorado en defensa cibernética. La iniciativa busca expandir el acceso a IA en el sector público.
bajada_en: OpenAI and GSA agree to offer eligible US governments zero license fees, 50% usage discounts, and enhanced cyber defense support. The initiative aims to expand AI access in the public sector.

title: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
summary: Meta has launched its new Muse assistant, marking the company's first real foray into AI-powered productivity tools. The company says its AI agent can "take the busywork off your plate" by helping you with online shopping, emails, trip-planning, and more. I decided to try out the new tool and see how well it performed - […]
title_es: Meta presenta Muse, su nuevo asistente de productividad
bajada: Meta lanza Muse, su primer asistente de IA para tareas de productividad, capaz de ayudar en compras, emails, planificación de viajes y más. La herramienta representa la entrada formal de Meta en el mercado de agentes de IA empresariales.
bajada_en: Meta launches Muse, its first AI productivity assistant capable of helping with shopping, emails, trip planning, and more. The tool marks Meta's formal entry into the AI agent market for business tasks.

title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
summary: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.
title_es: Listen Labs abandona ronda de $1.5B para hablar con Salesforce
bajada: La startup de investigación en IA Listen Labs canceló una ronda Serie C firmada con Menlo Ventures para explorar conversaciones con Salesforce. El movimiento sugiere un posible acuerdo o inversión de mayor envergadura con la compañía de software empresarial.
bajada_en: AI research startup Listen Labs scrapped a signed Series C funding round with Menlo Ventures to pursue talks with Salesforce. The move suggests a potential larger deal or investment opportunity with the enterprise software company.

title: Maven Robotics wants to steal your robot deployment deal
summary: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth today with a $100 million Series A and active deployments.
title_es: Maven Robotics sale de sigilo con $100M y despliegues activos
bajada: Maven Robotics emerge del sigilo con una ronda Serie A de $100 millones y ya tiene despliegues activos en clientes. La empresa busca capturar oportunidades en el mercado de automatización robótica acelerado por IA.
bajada_en: Maven Robotics emerges from stealth with a $100 million Series A and active customer deployments. The company aims to capture opportunities in the AI-accelerated robotics automation market.

title: Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn’t use their work
summary: Another researcher is challenging OpenAI about the data driving its increasingly impressive array of mathematical discoveries. Just days after a bitter row erupted over whether the company's models benefited from unpublished work, a second mathematician has come forward accusing the AI giant of unethical and "dishonest" behavior and a lack of transparency about the origins […]
title_es: Matemáticos cuestionan a OpenAI sobre uso de investigaciones
bajada: Un segundo matemático acusa a OpenAI de falta de transparencia sobre el origen de sus datos de entrenamiento para descubrimientos matemáticos. La denuncia se suma a controversias recientes sobre si OpenAI utilizó investigación no publicada en sus modelos.
bajada_en: A second mathematician accuses OpenAI of lacking transparency about training data origins for mathematical discoveries. The allegation adds to recent controversies about whether OpenAI used unpublished research in its models.

title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
summary: Suno's new v6 AI music model is its first made with support from the record industry. Suno's Jack Brody told The Verge that v6 was "trained from the ground up, with a new set of data that does not include the same data that our previous models were trained on." The data includes content licensed […]
title_es: Suno lanza v6, su primer modelo con apoyo de la industria
bajada: Suno presenta su modelo v6 de música IA entrenado con apoyo de la industria discográfica usando datos con licencia. El modelo marca un cambio importante hacia IA musical desarrollada con consentimiento de derechos de autor.
bajada_en: Suno releases v6, its first AI music model trained with record industry support using licensed data. The model marks a significant shift toward AI music development with copyright consent.

title: Clearview AI Is Testing an AI Tool That Would Let Cops Unearth Your Life Online
summary: InquiryIQ, a previously unreported prototype, tested a model from xAI, maker of Grok, to surface associates, social accounts, and other information about people identified through Clearview.
title_es: Clearview AI prueba herramienta de vigilancia policial con xAI
bajada: Clearview AI desarrolla InquiryIQ, un prototipo que utiliza el modelo Grok de xAI para que policías rastreen información personal, asociados y cuentas de redes sociales de personas. La herramienta plantea serias preocupaciones sobre privacidad y vigilancia masiva.
bajada_en: Clearview AI develops InquiryIQ, a prototype using xAI's Grok model to help police track personal information, associates, and social accounts of individuals. The tool raises serious privacy and mass surveillance concerns.

title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
summary: AI inference chipmaker d-Matrix today announced it will use NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure platform — joining a growing roster of ecosystem partners. By connecting Raptor to NVIDIA NVLink scale-up and Spectrum-X scale-out networking, the NVIDIA MGX rack architecture and the broader NVIDIA AI platform, NVLink Fusion […]
title_es: d-Matrix adopta NVIDIA NVLink para infraestructura de IA
bajada: El fabricante de chips d-Matrix anunciará el uso de NVIDIA NVLink Fusion para conectar sus XPUs Raptor a la plataforma de infraestructura de IA de NVIDIA. La integración amplía el ecosistema de partners y las opciones de escalabilidad para inferencia.
bajada_en: AI chipmaker d-Matrix announces adoption of NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA's AI infrastructure platform. The integration expands the partner ecosystem and scalability options for inference.

title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
summary: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.
title_es: OpenAI aboga por regulación de IA mientras haya oportunidad
bajada: Chris Lehane argumenta que capacidades de IA más fuertes requieren evidencia de seguridad más sólida, estándares compartidos y políticas duraderas. El documento enfatiza la importancia de actuar en el actual contexto político favorable para la regulación.
bajada_en: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action. The piece emphasizes the importance of acting while the political window for regulation remains open.

title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
summary: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.
title_es: Paul Christiano se une a la Junta de la Fundación OpenAI
bajada: Paul Christiano, experto en alineación y seguridad de IA, se incorpora a la Junta de la Fundación OpenAI y su Comité de Seguridad. El nombramiento refuerza el enfoque de la organización en estándares de seguridad y alineación.
bajada_en: Paul Christiano, expert in AI alignment and safety, joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and Safety and Security Committee. The appointment strengthens the organization's focus on safety standards and alignment.

title: Rebuilding AUTOMATIC1111 with Gradio Workflow
title_es: Hugging Face reconstruye AUTOMATIC1111 con Gradio Workflow
bajada: Hugging Face presenta una reconstrucción de la popular herramienta AUTOMATIC1111 usando Gradio Workflow, mejorando accesibilidad y funcionalidad. La iniciativa facilita a developers crear pipelines de generación de imágenes sin código complejo.
bajada_en: Hugging Face rebuilds the popular AUTOMATIC1111 tool using Gradio Workflow, improving accessibility and functionality. The initiative makes it easier for developers to create image generation pipelines without complex coding.

title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
title_es: IBM lanza modelo Granite Time Series con licencia comercial
bajada: IBM Research publica Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, un modelo de última generación para series temporales con licencia comercial favorable. El modelo está disponible en Hugging Face y permite a developers entrenar sobre datos históricos con libertad comercial.
bajada_en: IBM Research releases Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, a state-of-the-art time series model with commercial-friendly licensing. The model is available on Hugging Face and allows developers to train on historical data with commercial freedom.
